Hero.sub: 7 years building accessible, production-ready React & Next.js interfaces at CookUnity. Focus on performance, design systems, and the details most people skip.

About.sub: I'm Florencia, a Frontend Engineer with 7 years of experience building scalable web applications with React, TypeScript, and Next.js — most recently on CookUnity's Growth team, owning the homepage and landing pages that bring new users in.
About.secondSub: I specialize in translating product and design requirements into polished, production-ready interfaces: reusable components, responsive layouts, and accessible experiences that hold up under real traffic, not just in Figma.
About.thirdSub: I care about the parts that are easy to skip — semantic markup, keyboard navigation, Core Web Vitals — because that's what separates an interface that looks done from one that actually works for everyone.
About.lastSub: Outside of work, I build small tools to keep my fundamentals sharp: component libraries, headless CMS integrations, and the odd side project that has no deadline but me.

Projects.span2: A React and TypeScript component library with Storybook, wired to a headless CMS.
Projects.span3: Rebuilding the patterns I used at work (CMS-driven components, accessible by default) as a public project I can show.
Projects.span4: Stack: React · TypeScript · Tailwind · Storybook · Strapi

Contact.sub: If you're looking for a frontend engineer who's comfortable owning a feature from architecture to shipped pixel — reach out.
Contact.successMessage: Message sent successfully! I'll get back to you shortly.

Experience.bullet1: Rebuilt the company homepage from scratch during a full rebranding, with custom tablet layouts and animated components (carousels, accordions), and owned it and its satellite pages for 5 years.
Experience.bullet2: Built a centralized promotions engine (React Context and a priority-chain algorithm) to manage business logic across the landing pages, resolving data inconsistencies that had been generating a steady volume of support tickets.
Experience.bullet3: Migrated the landing page platform from Next.js Pages Router to App Router incrementally, validating performance and functionality route by route.
Experience.bullet4: Built and maintained 20+ landing pages in Next.js, plus a library of about 60 reusable components (React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Storybook, Atomic Design) connected to Strapi, so Marketing could build and edit pages without developers.
Experience.bullet5: Owned performance, SEO and accessibility for the landing platform: improved LCP by reworking image delivery, font loading and third-party scripts, with semantic, keyboard-navigable markup across the pages.
Experience.bullet6: Ran 30+ A/B experiments and feature rollouts (Unleash, Segment), including onboarding funnel variations built with Redux, working daily with designers, product managers and backend engineers.
